evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Plain unhedged assertion of what the test does — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification or operational settling language to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule with modal 'must' stated twice — a settled, load-bearing requirement the speaker expects others to act on, not a position still being argued.
